answer_1.quote: Using PEACOK, we augment a persona-grounded dialogue model P 2 BOT  developed on the ConvAI2 (Dinan et al., 2020) PERSONA-CHAT  dataset.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate COMET-BART on a test set from PEACOK containing 3030 facts with unique head-relation combinations.

answer_4.quote: Two expert annotators from our research group manually compare four aspects of the response generation quality: fluency, whether the response is fluent and understandable, consistency, where the response is consistent with the dialogue history, engagement, whether the response is engaging and interesting, and persona expression, whether the response demonstrates persona information related to the interlocutor's profile.
answer_4.guideline: We ask the experts to compare the two responses with regard to our four evaluation aspects (i.e., fluency, consistency, engagement and persona expression).
